title: Reversal confirmation
description: The origin reserve's own signed statement that a reversed segment's value arrived (ADR-0008, REQ-ORD-3, DEC-14).

reversal_confirmation.description: That one credit arrived: the segment's transaction, amount and asset, and nothing else. Never a claim about sufficiency in general (ADR-0008, REQ-CAT-4). Its maker and time are the envelope's; it is recorded as the reserve's word (REQ-ORD-3).

segment.description: The transaction of the reversed segment.

asset.description: The asset the credit arrived in.
